title: The Effects of Search Interface on Consumer Preferences: Evidence from a Randomized Experiment
eligible_reason: Randomized, incentive-aligned online experiment (1,200 participants, four search-interface conditions) with pre- and post-search conjoint studies. Treatment randomized at the participant level; regressions of pre-post changes on condition dummies and mediation analyses. No staggered adoption design.
design_notes: 2.attribute_importance.R: lm(range ~ condition + condition*after); lm(diff ~ c2 + c3 + c4 + M + c*M); 3.mediation.R mediation regressions; hierarchical Bayes conjoint part-worths (Stan).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available; screened from package README/code and the OpenAlex abstract (data/frame/mksc.jsonl).
